notes.title: Pumpkin Park Spook-tacular Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🎃

Big thanks for all your feedback and support. We've been hard at work fixing a few spooky issues:

[list]
[*][b]Pumpkins behaving:[/b] The pumpkin doors now properly update with your pumpkins scores. You can finally unlock those extra levels without a hitch!
[*][b]Spawn point fixed:[/b] No more ghostly returns to Hightower when leaving new zones. You’ll land right where you're supposed to!
[/list]

Thanks again for playing, and happy adventuring in Pumpkin Park! 🎃👻

Best,
Adins

notes.title: Halloween Special: The Pumpkin Park!
notes.notes:
🎃 Trick or Treat? 🎃

Happy Halloween, adventurers! 🕸️👻

The Grand Witch has brewed up something extra special for this spooky season… a FREE Halloween DLC is now live!

Prepare yourselves for a haunting adventure with 4 brand-new characters to uncover. To unlock the DLC, simply update the game and collect 15 stars. Once you’re ready, head over to Adventure Mode, journey far to the left (past the crypt!), and seek out the mysterious gate. Who knows what creepy surprises await beyond... 😈

What's new in this Halloween update?

🎃 [b]New Zone: Pumpkin Park[/b] – Explore a creepy, pumpkin-filled wonderland ruled by Amarantha, the Grand Witch's sly sister.
🕵️‍♀️ [b]4 New Characters[/b] – Discover spooky new faces hiding in Pumpkin Park.
🎩 [b]New Pot: Pumpkin Edition[/b] – A new pumpkin-themed pot to help you collect those souls.
🎶 [b]More Music Variety[/b] – We’ve added fresh, eerie tunes to set the mood for your adventure.

Update the game now, grab your stars, and head to Pumpkin Park for some Halloween fun! 🎃👻
